title: Operation recipe
description: A saved definition of one operation, including unfinished intent. Bundle supplies its stable identity and saved revision; authoring does not start execution.

id.description: Stable recipe identity within its Bundle.

revision.description: Saved definition revision, minted by Bundle.

operation.description: The named owner and operation. It may be absent, null or unfinished while the person authors intent. The operation owner validates its arguments before execution.

arguments.description: Explicit operation-specific finite data. Geometry, spacing, process and feature choices are interpreted by the named operation owner.

inputs.description: Named immutable inputs, supplied as saved values or another recipe's named output. Submission resolves these links internally.

x-saam.admission: Every field, including additional fields, is finite plain data. Admission rejects cycles, native objects, proxies, accessors, symbols, sparse arrays and undefined, and captures an immutable copy. A collection additionally requires distinct recipe IDs.
guarantees: A Bundle may hold many recipes, including unfinished intent.
The executor follows authored input links; only the operation owner interprets fabrication arguments.
Known immutable inputs may be supplied with their identities without another agent read.
Authoring recipes does not start solves. A separate explicit submission admits one Bundle pipeline job through Scheduler; recipes never run independent followers.
